# Integration test fixture provenance

Generated by dlwotjd1289-cloud/ahead-dataset-generator at commit
766d1ee179e7efe3b8b75b0813c1918dca26bc90 (generator 1.2.0).
Source: https://github.com/dlwotjd1289-cloud/ahead-dataset-generator

The upstream default configuration was used with only
generation.benchmark.boxes_per_scenario changed from 24 to 6.
The exact config is generator.yaml. Command: generate_dataset.py
--config generator.yaml --mode sample --sample-per-family 1.

There are 6 families, 36 observations, and train/val/test counts 4/1/1.
ground_truth and analysis are intentionally not included: this adapter does not
consume them. file_hashes.json retains the original full hash index; the adapter
verifies only the scenario and observation files it actually reads.

These are synthetic software test inputs, not field measurements or model
performance evidence. The source's manifest git_commit is UNKNOWN because the
source was read at a pinned commit through GitHub file APIs without a .git clone;
the verified commit is recorded above.
